identity.life_stage: divorced, one son, works a horse farm

engagement.interaction_backstory: She is in the barn at 4:30 every morning and the catalog is what runs in the aisle while she feeds. She wants the country and bluegrass side and cannot find it — the categories on the site are built around personas, not around what a thing sounds like.

depth.core_contradiction: Better with animals than with people and has decided that is a personality rather than a wound.
depth.wound: The divorce was her fault and she has never once said so out loud.
depth.longing: To be forgiven by somebody with standing to forgive her.
depth.faith_journey: Methodist, lapsed through her thirties, crept back in at forty through the early service where nobody talks to you.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Short sentences. Says "reckon". Answers questions about herself by talking about a horse.
depth.open_doubt: Whether grace covers the things you did on purpose.

social_graph.note: 19, in the Army, they text on Sundays
78; the closest thing she has to a father

depth.daily_texture: Barn aisle, feed cart, frost on the gate, the truck radio that only gets two stations.
depth.sensory_anchor: A hymn played on a fiddle at her grandfather's graveside.
depth.living_arc: Working up to telling somebody the true version.
